title: Restore four evaluators to stop manufacturing false silence
notes: Sixteen flags had gone 39 to 45 hours without evaluations after the 20 August budget cut. They would have crossed the seven-day no-evaluations threshold around 27 August and looked archive-ready because nobody was watching, which is the precise failure this talk is about, manufactured by us.

Four evaluators is the cap the budget tool allows: twice the two that have actually been measured. Raw headroom suggested fifty-one, but cost scales super-linearly and extrapolating beyond the measured configuration is what caused the overrun.
Chosen for flag coverage: demo-storefront adds five flags, demo-profile adds three including the protected candidate demo-profile-preferences. Production coverage rises from seven flags to fifteen.
Measure a full day at four before considering eight. Spending at two evaluators was 0.011 per day against an allowance of 0.131.
